# Polarion MCP Server

> A self-hosted Model Context Protocol server for the Polarion ALM REST API.

The server provides tools for work items, requirements, LiveDocs, traceability, test management, projects and other Polarion resources. It connects to the customer's own Polarion instance.

## Install and connect

- [Local npm setup](guides/local-npm.md): run with Node.js and npm.
- [Server Docker setup](guides/server-docker.md): host the OCI image.
- [Client guides](clients.md): choose a local or remote MCP client.
- [Python package](https://pypi.org/project/polarion-alm-mcp/): launcher for the matching npm release.
- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/phillipboesger/polarion-mcp/releases): Claude Desktop `.mcpb` bundle.
